claims.claim_text: voxeljet states it has named multinational customers including Daimler AG, BMW AG, Ford Motor Company, Volkswagen AG, Porsche SE, and Evonik Industries AG.
claims.subject: voxeljet
claims.object_value: Daimler, BMW, Ford, VW, Porsche, Evonik
claims.source_quote: Out of our broad customer portfolio we deal with companies including Daimler AG, BMW AG, Ford Motor Company, Volkswagen AG, Porsche SE, Evonik Industries AG as well as with other key users of additive manufacturing.

claims.claim_text: voxeljet operates a US service center in Canton, Michigan with more than 40,000 square feet of production space.
claims.subject: voxeljet America (Canton, MI service center)
claims.source_quote: Further voxeljet has leased out production space to third parties in Canton, Michigan, US ... Our service centers in Germany and the United States each have more than 40,000 square feet of production space.

queries.note: Foreign-issuer caveat: light assembly/service may not be EPA-permitted

claims.claim_text: voxeljet asserts a worldwide patent portfolio of 71 issued US patents, 38 pending US patent applications, and over 469 patents and patent applications globally as of Dec 31, 2022.
claims.subject: voxeljet AG
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2022, we owned or co-owned 71 issued U.S. patents and 38 pending U.S. patent applications. ... our patent portfolio consisted of over 469 patents and patent applications.

claims.claim_text: voxeljet has license agreements with ExOne (now part of Desktop Metal as of 2021) and Stratasys-segment competitors (3D Systems via Z Corp); ExOne notified voxeljet of intent not to pay license fees and asserts breach.
claims.subject: voxeljet
claims.source_quote: we are a party to various licenses and other arrangements ... license agreements with ExOne, 3D Systems (Z Corp), Bego Medical GmbH ... In March 2018, ExOne GmbH ... notified us of their intent not to pay their annual license fees under this agreement.

queries.note: Stratasys (SSYS) — competitor and IP-overlap entity may discuss voxeljet

claims.claim_text: voxeljet asserts an installed base of 224 printers worldwide as of Dec 31, 2022, indicating real commercial deployment.
claims.subject: voxeljet
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2022, we had an installed base of 224 printers worldwide ...

queries.note: Same query as C1 broad — installed base should leave US filer footprint via reseller/customer disclosures

claims.claim_text: voxeljet asserts an EPA-relevant industrial activity at its US site through use of resins and binders (German plant requires Federal Emissions Control Act permit; US production handles same materials).
claims.subject: voxeljet America
claims.object_value: US service center in Canton MI with on-demand parts production using resins/binders
claims.source_quote: We do require a permit granted under the Federal Emissions Control Act ... as we use resins ( Harze ) to create models for customers.

claims.claim_text: voxeljet names BMW AG as a significant customer; BMW AG ADR is a US-listed filer (CIK 0001074929).

claims.claim_text: voxeljet competes with named US-listed industry peers including Stratasys (SSYS), 3D Systems Corporation, and HP Inc.; the additive manufacturing industry's biggest US-listed players should reference voxeljet in competitive landscape disclosures.

claims.source_quote: Some of the companies that have developed and use one or more additive manufacturing technologies to compete with us include: ExOne, 3D Systems Corporation, Stratasys, Ltd., EOS GmbH and HP Inc.
